why: Capture counts only a button that goes down after capture starts. The Confirm that chose the row is still held on the next frame, so a capture that took any held button would bind the action to Confirm's button every time a controller started it.
killedBy: createBindingCapture (issue #754) ignores the button already held when capture starts, and takes it once pressed again
the controller layout pane is painted, written and captured for by the page (issue #754) captures the next NEW press and stores both halves of the swap it makes
